messages:
alex: heads-up — hitting import/runtime/type issues when using the JS SDK inside a Next.js app-router app targeting Edge.

alex: symptoms: sometimes build fails with "TypeError: require is not a function" (CJS leak), sometimes dev shows "Cannot use import statement outside a module" depending on bundler, and on Vercel Edge we see "setTimeout is not defined" from our retry/backoff.

maria: ouch. paste error output?

alex: reproduced: Next server component importing SDK -> build error. Client component importing server bundle -> runtime errors. package.json currently only has main/module/types, no exports map.

jamal: that explains it. Next/edge need explicit exports and probably an edge-specific bundle that avoids node builtins.

alex: proposed package.json exports snippet we can ship: 
{ ".": { "import": "dist/index.esm.js", "require": "dist/index.cjs", "edge": "dist/index.edge.mjs" } }

maria: yes. also produce a browser entry (dist/browser.mjs) for client-only usage and a minimal index.edge.d.ts alongside index.edge.mjs so TS picks up correct typings.

sophie: TS note: dynamic import workarounds in server components lead to `any` types unless we ship declaration files per entrypoint or use typesVersions mapping.

jamal: for retry/backoff, remove setTimeout dependency in edge build. Detect globalThis.setTimeout and fallback to a promise-based spin or use the fetch Retry-After pattern. Edge bundles should be ESM-only and tree-shaken.

alex: temporary developer hack: you can force the edge entry from a server component via `await import('redwood-infer-sdk/dist/index.edge.mjs')` to unblock testing. We'll make a proper exports map soon.

maria: can someone open an SDK issue listing the export/type/build matrix and attach a small repro?

sophie: I opened https://github.com/redwood-inference/sdk/issues/312 and added labels: sdk, esm-cjs, edge, types, nextjs. linked repro: https://github.com/redwood-inference/devex-repros/next-edge-sdk-interop

jamal: checklist for implementation: add exports map, build index.edge.mjs without node-only APIs, ship per-entrypoint .d.ts files, add browser entry, update retry logic for edge, and add examples in Next sample showing server dynamic import and client usage.

alex: assigning follow-ups: maria + jamal for the SDK changes, sophie to update the devex sample.

build-bot: deploy queued for branch fix/edge-exports (CI #3421) :rocket:

sophie: will PR the sample update and link the SDK issue when ready.
